title: Continuous poll layer — 2026 cycle (line-by-line verified primary releases)
capturedFrom: primary pollster releases listed per entry (fetched directly; syndication is never the only source)
method: Every number below was transcribed from the pollster's own release (PDF or release page) or, for CNN/SSRS, from CNN's publication of its own poll with the SSRS methodology note. Field dates, population (RV/LV/adults), n and margin of error are recorded as published. Poll margins are converted to a Democratic win probability only for the side-by-side with Kalshi using the same logistic mapping as the 2024 poll backtest, p = 1/(1+exp(-margin/4.5)) — a labelled modelling choice, not a pollster claim. Aggregator readings (RealClearPolling) are recorded as aggregator readings, not as polls. Entries marked review:true carry toplines transcribed from the pollster's release page but their n / margin of error / field dates could not be fetched (publisher page blocked); they are shown with that caveat until reviewed. Session 7 (2026-09-20) rows: elon-2026-09-nc-senate, hpu-2026-04-nc-senate and harrisx-2026-08-generic (all carry methodFamily; HPU's 'moe' is the release's credibility interval, as its methodNote says); two pending items record what was verified but not transcribed.
policy: Only free, publicly available releases from school/academic research centres, established pollsters with published methodology, or the outlets that commission and publish them. Sponsored one-off polls without a methodology statement are not admitted. Nothing here is used to trade; the contest reads pollSignal only from the 2024 archive.

stateRaces.methodNote: 'fielded by YouGov on behalf of the High Point University Survey Research Center from March 26 through April 6, 2026, as an online survey using a panel of respondents ... collected 914 responses ... matched these responses down to 800'. The release states 'it is not appropriate to assign a classic margin of sampling error' and gives a credibility interval of ±4.1 (all 800) / ±4.3 (LV, n = 703) — the moe field here is that credibility interval, not a sampling MoE. Weighting: propensity-score matching to an ACS 2023 frame, raked on 2024 presidential vote and gender × age × race × education.

exitPollStatus.finding: For 2026 the network exit poll and AP VoteCast have been merged into 'The Voter Poll by SSRS' (launched for the November 2025 general election; SSRS acquired Edison Research, the NEP exit-poll provider since 2003). Partners: ABC News, AP, CBS News, CNN, Fox News Media, NBC News (and MSNOW per AP). AP states it returns results in every state with a Senate or governor race in a midterm year. No 2026 general-election exit-poll data exists before 2026-11-03, so none is used here.
